title: Texas Instruments Is Up 55% in 2026: This Is the Secret Tech Stock You’re Missing Out On
summary: While Wall Street obsesses over AI compute chips, one analog giant has quietly outpaced the S&P 500 by a factor of five this year, and the reason has nothing to do with artificial intelligence.

title: 1 Semiconductor Stock with Exciting Potential and 2 Facing Headwinds
summary: Semiconductors are the core infrastructure powering the Information Age. The amount of data we ingest is also increasing exponentially, leading to elevated demand for chips with more processing power. This secular trend bodes well for the industry, which has posted a six-month gain of 51.8% and beaten the S&P 500 by 38.5 percentage points.

title: Five Dividend Stocks Crushing Inflation With Consistent Dividend Payout Growth
summary: A static dividend yield quietly loses ground every month inflation climbs, but five companies have been raising their payouts fast enough to fight back. The question is which ones have the cash flow to keep doing it.

title: Qorvo, Qualcomm, Texas Instruments, Vishay Intertechnology, and Impinj Stocks Trade Up, What You Need To Know
summary: A number of stocks jumped in the morning session after macroeconomic relief from declining Treasury yields and lower oil prices, coupled with robust artificial intelligence demand projections, boosted sentiment across the chip industry.

title: Should Qualcomm Stockholders Worry About Its Shrinking Revenue?
summary: Qualcomm (QCOM) grew revenue just 1.9% over the last twelve months, against a compound pace of about 6.2% a year over five years and 4.5% over three. The quarterly path is worse. Across the last four quarters, year-over-year growth slid from 10.0% to 5.0%, then to declines of 3.5% and 4.0%. That turn to shrinking quarterly sales is the risk to weigh.

title: The Next Growth Cycle Could Take Qualcomm to New Highs
summary: Qualcomm's handset business is shrinking while its automotive and data center ambitions are scaling fast, and the tension between those two forces will determine whether the stock revisits its highs or stalls out entirely.

title: Texas Instruments (TXN) Registers a Bigger Fall Than the Market: Important Facts to Note
summary: Texas Instruments (TXN) concluded the recent trading session at $258.8, signifying a -1.07% move from its prior day's close.

title: Is Applied Materials Stock Amplifying A Risk You Already Own?
summary: Applied Materials (AMAT) has added 6.1% over the last five trading days, while the S&P 500 gained 0.1%, and a run like that pulls money in. The five-day move is not the question here. What matters is what this stock does to your money every time the market moves, because it travels much further than the index in both directions.

title: Qualcomm Stock Looks Cheap, But Is The Discount Deserved?
summary: Qualcomm (QCOM) trades at about $176 a share, down about 14% over the past three months and up 12.4% over the past twelve. At 20.1 times earnings against an S&P 500 median of 22.9, a profitable chip designer sits below the market. The question is whether that is a good business on sale or a fair price for a business under real pressure.

title: TXN Starts Raising Prices: Can Higher ASPs Boost Profits in 2026?
summary: Texas Instruments hikes prices as chip demand strengthens, adding a new lever for revenues and margins as unit volumes drive near-term growth.
